description: Spin up an Ironbox: a secure sandbox next to Hyperliquid where an agent trades on paper, with Ironflow data, analytics and alerts built in. No key needed: you get a trial box, the agent's own simulated Hyperliquid account for 24 hours, with base_url and expires_at. It ends sooner after 2 hours with no requests and no strategy running. Point the Hyperliquid SDK's base_url at it, or start a strategy on it with start_box_strategy. A free key keeps a box. A paper box never places a real order.
